name: md-lang-id-preserved
body: The structural scanner emits the existing `md` language id for Markdown, so every existing Markdown FQN is unchanged: the `md.<dir>` modules, the `md.AGENTS.md.<heading-path>` heading Structs, and the `md.opencode-suite/agents` subtree. This is a packaging consolidation (the Markdown frontend's code is absorbed into the bundled scanner), not a graph-identity break; emitting a new id (e.g. a `text` root) would move every Markdown FQN for no benefit. Acceptance: a post-change scan of this repo produces the same `md.*` module and heading FQN set as the pre-change scan, and the Markdown heading `Struct`s still resolve.
